evidence.reason: The negative lookahead only rejects tokens containing `O` or the listed long-option prefixes, while `_TOKEN` accepts arbitrary file paths. As a result, `git grep -f /outside/file` and `git ls-files -X /outside/file` match `SEARCH_PATTERNS` at line 33 and read files outside the worktree, contrary to the guard comment at lines 22-24. `git grep -f` can also surface pattern-file lines in regex-compilation errors. Extend the guard to reject `-f`/`-X` and the corresponding long options.
